summary: A weekly $5 buy-in pool tournament run by the bar Eda's Hide-a-Way in Weaverville, sign-ups due by 7pm each Monday. It reads as a standard barroom house tournament rather than an organized club: there is no league name, no membership language, and no dedicated group page separate from the venue itself.

evidence.note: All 15 listings use the identical terse description ('Pool night, every Monday night with a $5 buy in. Must be signed up by 7 p.m.') with no mention of members, regulars, or a named league/club.
Tags are generic bar/tournament descriptors (Barroom, Cash Buy In, Weekly Tournament, Sports) with nothing indicating a persistent membership roster.
The venue's own events page lists live music, trivia, line dancing, and a bluegrass jam but does not mention pool night at all, suggesting it isn't promoted as a flagship club activity.
Eda's Hide-a-Way is a general sports bar (pool, ping-pong, shuffleboard, live music, karaoke); no separate pool-league or pool-club Facebook group or page was found.
Search for the venue plus pool night surfaces only the venue's own listings and generic bar directory pages (Yelp, Explore Asheville, TicketSqueeze) - no independent community/league presence.
